title: Test a Polkit authorization rule
summary: If you have created a custom Polkit rule, you can manually check if a specific action is allowed for your current user without triggering the graphical authentication dialog.

steps.explain: Use pkcheck to verify if the current process (your shell) is authorized for a specific action ID. Replace <ACTION_ID> with the ID you want to test (e.g., org.freedesktop.timedate1.set-timezone).

placeholders.name: ACTION_ID
placeholders.description: The ID of the Polkit action to test, e.g., org.gnome.gparted
